answer: Foreign workers employed in construction may change employers only quarterly, on January 1st, April 1st, July 1st and October 1st, after giving lawful advance notice in writing to their employers.
informationLabel: This summary is provided for general informational purposes only, and is not a substitute for the wording of the relevant laws, regulations, procedures and extension orders, which are binding.

claims.quote: Foreign workers employed in the construction industry may only change employers quarterly, on January 1st, April 1st, July 1st and October 1st of each year, after giving lawful advance notice in writing to their employers.
